contract: Candidates use native padded single-file rectangles. Alpha bounds are local crop coordinates; occurrences are exact native-frame sheet crops. Committed render rectangles are separate packed coordinates. Required-neighbor overlay offset is relative to the full bed frame. Source-over layers reconstruct finite experiment canvases.

scope.surveyRegion: S02-I31; related master context only for complete beds
scope.description: One natural-wood/pale-gray side-bed body, two pillow colors, two headboard ends, plus blue star/moon-like cloth overlays at each end; all three actual render sets.

candidates.label: Pale-gray bed, blue pillow at right

identity.value: Pale-gray bed, blue pillow at right
identity.evidence: Closed side-view frame has one tall headboard, a pillow on the mattress, a closed pale-gray cover and small feet under the near rail. Native padding is not an assembly cut.
alternatives: sofa/daybed; no back running along long edge, while pillow/headboard support bed interpretation

family.value: tan/brown-frame side-bed with pale-gray bedding and optional blue patterned blanket
family.evidence: Exact selected body signatures repeat across shadow sets; all four beds share the same rail, feet, mattress texture and one end headboard.

style.value: wood-like tan/brown frame; softly patterned bedding
style.evidence: Brown rails and tan end post resemble wood, but pixels do not establish physical material, age, vendor style name or fabric type.

role.evidence: Closed side-view frame has one tall headboard, a pillow on the mattress, a closed pale-gray cover and small feet under the near rail. Native padding is not an assembly cut.

facing.value: side view; pillow/headboard at image-right; compass heading unknown
facing.evidence: The pillow/headboard position and long near rail are visible; no world compass convention is established.

variant.value: pale-gray mattress/cover, blue pillow, tan/brown frame; normal
variant.evidence: Selected counterpart comparison proves an identical opaque body, changing only pixels outside the shadowless body; black-shadow filenames have different numbers.

topology.limits: Recipes retain same-render labels and matching pillow end; all three cover render exports are byte-identical, so same-render naming is bookkeeping rather than a pixel difference. Tested at full-frame offset [0,16] on the two selected pillow colors. No arbitrary bed/cloth fitting, repetition, mirroring or runtime placement rule.
